lines.text: Can I tag along to the movie?

data.define: To go with a group that didn't invite you directly.

example.text: Can I tag along to the movie?

misuse.text: Don't 'tag along' on someone's private date.

publish.title: What does "tag along" mean?
publish.value: Tag along = Come with others. Example: "Can I tag along to the movie?" (casual English).
